### CVE-2023-4344 — Broadcom RAID Controller web interface is vulnerable to insufficient randomness due to improper use of ssl.rnd to setup CIM connection
- Assigner: certcc | Published: 2023-08-15 | Updated: 2025-11-04 | Max CVSS: 9.8
- CWE: CWE-331 CWE-331: Insufficient Entropy
- CVSS 3.1 (CISA-ADP): 9.8 CRITICAL `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=yes, Technical Impact=total

Broadcom RAID Controller web interface is vulnerable to insufficient randomness due to improper use of ssl.rnd to setup CIM connection

**solutions:** This issue is fixed in 7.017.011.000. For more information please contact your Broadcom representative.

Affected:
- Broadcom / LSI Storage Authority (LSA): affected 0 <7.017.011.000 (custom)
- Intel / RAID Web Console 3 (RWC3): affected 0 <7.017.011.000 (custom)

Credits: Intel DCG

References:
- https://www.broadcom.com/support/resources/product-security-center
- https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/security-center/advisory/intel-sa-00926.html

### CVE-2023-42099 — Intel Driver & Support Assistant Link Following Local Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
- Assigner: zdi | Published: 2024-05-03 | Updated: 2024-08-15 | Max CVSS: 7.8
- CWE: CWE-59 CWE-59: Improper Link Resolution Before File Access ('Link Following')
- CVSS 3.0 (cna): 7.8 HIGH `CVSS:3.0/AV:L/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=no, Technical Impact=total

Intel Driver & Support Assistant Link Following Local Privilege Escalation Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows local attackers to escalate privileges on affected installations of Intel Driver & Support Assistant. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability.

The specific flaw exists within the DSA Service. By creating a symbolic link, an attacker can abuse the service to delete a file. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to escalate privileges and execute arbitrary code in the context of SYSTEM. Was ZDI-CAN-21846.

Affected:
- Intel / Driver & Support Assistant: affected 23.3.25.6
- intel / driver\&support_assistant: affected 23.3.25.6

References:
- https://www.zerodayinitiative.com/advisories/ZDI-23-1449/ [x_research-advisory]

### CVE-2023-50197 — Intel Driver & Support Assistant Link Following Local Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
- Assigner: zdi | Published: 2024-05-03 | Updated: 2024-08-15 | Max CVSS: 7.8
- CWE: CWE-59 CWE-59: Improper Link Resolution Before File Access ('Link Following')
- CVSS 3.0 (cna): 7.8 HIGH `CVSS:3.0/AV:L/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=no, Technical Impact=total

Intel Driver & Support Assistant Link Following Local Privilege Escalation Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows local attackers to escalate privileges on affected installations of Intel Driver & Support Assistant. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability.

The specific flaw exists within the DSA Service. By creating a symbolic link, an attacker can abuse the service to write a file. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to escalate privileges and execute arbitrary code in the context of SYSTEM. Was ZDI-CAN-21845.

Affected:
- Intel / Driver & Support Assistant: affected 23.3.25.6
- intel / driver\&support_assistant: affected 23.3.25.6

References:
- https://www.zerodayinitiative.com/advisories/ZDI-23-1773/ [x_research-advisory]

### CVE-2023-52161
- Assigner: mitre | Published: 2024-02-22 | Updated: 2025-11-04 | Max CVSS: 7.5
- CWE: n/a; CWE-287 CWE-287 Improper Authentication
- CVSS 3.1 (CISA-ADP): 7.5 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:N/A:N`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=yes, Technical Impact=partial

The Access Point functionality in eapol_auth_key_handle in eapol.c in iNet wireless daemon (IWD) before 2.14 allows attackers to gain unauthorized access to a protected Wi-Fi network. An attacker can complete the EAPOL handshake by skipping Msg2/4 and instead sending Msg4/4 with an all-zero key.

Affected:
- n/a / n/a: affected n/a
- intel / inet_wireless_daemon: affected 0 <2.14 (custom)
